rejection_summary.title: Furie
rejection_summary.reason: Whole-film evidence conflicts about sustained density. A Screen Anarchy review reports only a handful of unevenly spaced action scenes and a strong late train finale after extensive mother-daughter setup; other reviewers praise the fighting and momentum. Without sufficiently consistent evidence that action occupies most of the 98-minute runtime, do not promote this film today on the strength of its climactic choreography alone.
